items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; candidate_exclusion_reason excluded_intervention_type; thiotepa, etoposide, melphalan, fludarabine = excluded_intervention_type
items.reason: The chemotherapy is the conditioning regimen for allogeneic HCT ('Rate of grade III or higher organ toxicity attributable to conditioning'); D31-B8 makes drugs given to support a cell therapy part of the excluded therapy (role excluded_intervention_type).

'Giving chemotherapy before a donor stem cell transplant ... helps make room in the patient's bone marrow' describes the HCT conditioning step, which D31-B8 treats as part of the excluded cell therapy; the trial question is the tolerability of HCT.

Inclusion lists 'malignant glioma' with 'High grade tumors defined as those that are grade III or higher based on WHO classification' and no IDH requirement, which D31-B3 counts as grade 4 allowed under D30-R7 (historical glioblastoma); because glioma is enrolled alongside medulloblastoma, ATRT, germ cell tumours etc., D31-B15 gives basket_gbm_eligible.
D30-R7 (with D31-B3) assigns historical to grade III-or-higher glioma without an IDH requirement; no WHO 2021 citation in the record.

note: Inclusion change: S5 now passes (basket_gbm_eligible under D31-B3/B15 with D30-R7), so the trial is excluded at S6 (excluded_intervention_type) instead of S5. XL to confirm that B15's 'when GBM is named' is met by R7 historical glioblastoma; if not, mixed_glioma_gbm_named (basket false) per D30-R7 alone gives the same S6 exclusion. Conditioning chemotherapy roles are excluded_intervention_type under D31-B8 (allogeneic HCT treated as the cell therapy). Mixed age (CHILD, ADULT).

revisions.reason: 'malignant glioma' with 'grade III or higher based on WHO classification' counts as grade 4 allowed under D30-R7, and glioma is enrolled with non-glioma brain tumours (D31-B15).
D30-R7 assigns historical to the included grade III-or-higher glioma wording; no IDH or WHO 2021 reference in the record.
The trial enrols malignant glioma alongside medulloblastoma, PNET, ATRT, CNS germ cell tumour and other non-glioma brain tumours.
